claim: On the identical planted APK, disrobe frisk recalls more of the hand-verified planted secrets than apkleaks (it catches the AWS secret key, the Basic-auth credential, and the JWT that apkleaks's rule set misses).
detail: `disrobe frisk` recalls 100.0% of the planted secrets; apkleaks recalls 62.5%. apkleaks misses the AWS key, HTTP Basic credential, and JWT. This row scores only the shared 8-secret ground truth.

oracle.external: recall against the hand-verified planted ground-truth secret set committed in corpus/recon/apk/planted-secrets.apk; the planted secrets are the ground truth, so this is a non-circular recall oracle
oracle.note: Recall is strong (the planted secrets are ground truth). Precision against a real non-secret tree is a separate, weaker number not claimed here. apkleaks scans its own jadx-decompiled output tree; disrobe frisk scans the extracted member tree (its real product path); both see the byte-identical APK.

reproduce: cargo run -p disrobe-bench-head-to-head  (apkleaks 2.6.3 via evidence/competitors/install-linux.sh; rule set pinned at evidence/competitors/apkleaks-regexes.json; needs jadx for apkleaks's decompile step)
title: Secret / IOC recall: disrobe frisk vs apkleaks
